title: Vodafone Ltd v Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs
description: The contracting authority awarded the £184 million ECHO 2 contract to Fujitsu, but Vodafone challenged the evaluation process on two grounds: (1) Fujitsu's initial tender failed to meet a minimum quality threshold, and (2) the scoring of tenders was flawed. The challenge triggered an automatic suspension, which Mr Justice Kerr declined to lift, allowing Vodafone's claims to proceed.
contracting_authority_name: Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs
